historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved a twenty-unit condominium subdivision for a new building, on conditions of an affirmative-action sales programme and landscaping to a plan agreed with the neighbourhood; three commissioners abstained over a pending lawsuit (Resolution 8213).

The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and granted the permit to alter the building at 380 Monterey Boulevard, with a stipulation that the elevator shaft not exceed 50 feet in height.
